native_adaptations: One output lifetime replaces two lifetimes tied to an unused Input; explicit Table annotations migrate to Table<'a>.
Native adapters cover Output/ConsoleSectionOutput/OutputReference/OutputStyle/Box; arbitrary OutputInterface is a separate pending contract.
Direct section supports append; wrapping a style does not become a section; old append fixtures migrate to their actual direct target.
Factory uses root console section only for actual terminal output with no style parents; capture stream remains capture.
Factory clones named guide, info header, does not emit trailing LF; local mutations do not affect registry.
fixes: Default Table writes use type0 rather than explicit Normal32, preserving quiet nested style counters.
